name: Natose
source:
Yume's personal attendant and also the head for the security of Kuonji mansion, known for her blue hair and eyepatch, and love of food. If it has something to do with obtaining food, she is shown to have superhuman abilities. Out of all the characters she is the only one that does not overlook Yume. According to Ren's observation, she had always wished for having a little brother and thus Ren calls her "big sis". When in battle she takes a Muay Thai stance.

[Based on [url=https://en.m.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Kimi_ga_Aruji_de_Shitsuji_ga_Ore_de&diffonly=true]Wikipedia[/url]]
